playsExplainer.fill: Buy it tonight if you already wanted it. Copies dried. New lows stopped. Collector product now. Not a promise it pays.
playsExplainer.watch-floor: Mark the low. Do not dump under it. Do not buy the first bounce. Turns into Fill when the next dip sits above that low on fewer copies, and extra boxes look done.
playsExplainer.wait: Do nothing tonight. New lows are still printing, or the shape is early.
playsExplainer.dont-chase: The listed price already jumped. Paying tonight is paying after the move.
playsExplainer.pass: Walk away. More copies just hit at a high listed price.
playsExplainer.hold: Keep what you already own only while copies for sale keep leaving.

rules: Tools decide. A person does not lock a play.
Never Fill on climax-only. Never buy the climax day.
Still cutting (new low in last 3 days) is Wait.
Set still in play cannot Fill — Watch the floor at most.
eBay listings are not TCG solds are not a print run.
